name: RPCS3/rpcs3
description: The world's first free and open-source PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger, written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. Supports over 3500 games with active development.
score_rationale: Landmark open-source achievement with 18.4k stars; the definitive PS3 emulator maintained through early 2026 with broad game compatibility.
summary: Definitive open-source PlayStation 3 emulator with 3500+ game support
